async def act(page):
    # Wait for the page to load after previous actions
    await page.wait_for_timeout(3000)
    
    # Look for any project headings or links that might contain 'ChatGPT'
    # First, try to find headings with role 'heading' that could be project names
    try:
        # Get all headings on the page
        headings = page.get_by_role('heading')
        count = await headings.count()
        for i in range(count):
            heading = headings.nth(i)
            text = await heading.text_content()
            if 'ChatGPT' in text:
                project_name = text.strip()
                # Use the knowledge base function to navigate to project details
                await navigate_to_project_details(page, project_name)
                break
        else:
            # If no heading found, try links
            links = page.get_by_role('link')
            count = await links.count()
            for i in range(count):
                link = links.nth(i)
                text = await link.text_content()
                if 'ChatGPT' in text:
                    project_name = text.strip()
                    await navigate_to_project_details(page, project_name)
                    break
            else:
                raise ValueError("Project 'ChatGPT' not found in headings or links.")
    except Exception as e:
        # If still not found, the project might be listed differently; re-search
        searchbox = page.get_by_role("searchbox", name="Filter by name")
        await searchbox.fill("")
        await searchbox.fill("ChatGPT")
        await searchbox.press("Enter")
        await page.wait_for_timeout(2000)
        # Try again after search
        headings = page.get_by_role('heading')
        count = await headings.count()
        for i in range(count):
            heading = headings.nth(i)
            text = await heading.text_content()
            if 'ChatGPT' in text:
                project_name = text.strip()
                await navigate_to_project_details(page, project_name)
                break
        else:
            raise ValueError("Project 'ChatGPT' still not found after re-search.")
    
    # After navigating to project details, click the 'Fork' button
    await page.wait_for_timeout(3000)
    fork_button = page.get_by_role("button", name="Fork")
    await fork_button.click()
    await page.wait_for_timeout(5000)
    return "Forked ChatGPT project successfully."
